subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: After correcting the stale capability mapping, should Copilot native search auto-enable from a maintained allowlist, and should the shared payload-replacement policy be supported public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The stale IDs are a concrete defect, but the permanent capability source, automatic routing default, and third-party API contract require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a maintained capability contract
options.body: Use current supported model data with retirement tests, exact-head live proof, and the shared public helper.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep managed search as the default until Copilot exposes a stable capability field.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Centralize the two bundled implementations without adding a supported public Plugin SDK export.

recommendation.title: Approve a maintained capability contract
recommendation.body: Use current supported model data with retirement tests, exact-head live proof, and the shared public helper.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most strongly connects this person to Copilot routing and the provider SDK seams whose default and public contract require a decision.
